data:
Run a suite file locally against your MCP servers (BYOK or MCPJam-hosted
inference). Results are never uploaded.
  --inference <mode>            auto (default), byok, or mcpjam
  --reporter <format>           Write a report to stdout: json-summary,
  --out <path>                  Write the report to this file (the --reporter
  --api-key <key>               MCPJam sk_ API key (overrides MCPJAM_API_KEY)
  --project <id-or-name>        Project name or ID (defaults to the most
                                recently updated project)
